claims.source_quote_ar: كما قالت قريش لرسول الله ﷺ: لولا أُنزل عليه آية من ربه
claims.claim_ar: أسلوب طلب/أمر في «فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا» - طلب إحضار الحجة كوسيلة لتحدي مصداقية النبي.
claims.claim_en: Imperative/request in 'Bring to us what you promise' — an imperative-demand that functions as a challenge asking the prophet to supply proof of his claim.
claims.rhetorical_effect: confronts and tests the prophet’s claim; rhetorically shifts the burden of proof onto the prophet, producing scepticism and mock-challenge.

claims.source_quote_ar: ما من رسول إلا واجه قومه بهذا القول
claims.claim_ar: عتاب/تنبيه (إتْناب) في عبارة المشركين «قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا»؛ صيغة تُستخدم للتوبيخ والتقليل من أثر دعوته، واستبعاد صدقيته.
claims.claim_en: An admonishing rebuke (itnaab) in the phrase 'You have argued with us' — a reproachful formulation used to dismiss and belittle the prophet's persistent call, implying disbelief in his truthfulness.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted commentary is a general remark on prophetic encounters; it supports the identification of a rebuking rhetorical move but does not explicitly analyze the specific phrasing of this verse.
